newsitem.title: USA: Florida Panthers acquires lease for arena.
newsitem.headline: Florida Panthers acquires lease for arena.

text.p: Florida Panthers Holdings Inc on Tuesday said it agreed to acquire the lease to operate Gold Coast Ice Arena from NinjenRode Inc.
Terms of the agreement were not disclosed in the statement issued by the company. Officials were not immediately available to comment.
The Florida Panthers of the National Hockey League use to arena as a practice rink.
The company said it would issue about 34,760 shares of Florida Panthers Holdings Inc class A common stock to fulfill the terms of agreement.

In addition to the hockey club, Florida Panthers Holdings Inc owns the Arena Development and Arena Operating Cos, the Hyatt Regency Pier 66 Resort and Marina, the Radisson Bahia Mar Resort and Yachting Center, Incredible Ice Skating Rinks and an interest in the Miami Arena.
